decompose_or_block.description: One unconditional action (save a note) plus one part gated on a check that always comes back empty (no tentative events to delete). Correct behavior: save the note regardless -- it was never conditional on the calendar check. A weaker agent treats the empty check result as blocking the WHOLE task, including the unconditional note -- the real 'Yoga scenario' failure shape (development_log.md, 2026-09-13). Objectively checks whether the note was actually saved (a real tool call), not just whether the agent talked about it.
